{{Top|leg}}
'''Hullepi''' were the fleshy tentacles that hung from the face and neck of a [[Khil]]. It was through these that they breathed,<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> making a wheezing sound.
